relationships.subject: PF-05089771
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of Na<sub>V</sub>1.7, using PF-05089771, had a small inhibitory effect on mechanoreceptor responses to distension.

relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: Tetrodotoxin-sensitive conduction was abolished in many esophageal neurons by PF-05089771 alone, indicating a critical role of Na<sub>V</sub>1.7.

key_findings: All four TTX-sensitive Nav1 subtypes (1.1, 1.2, 1.6, 1.7) contribute to action potential initiation in esophageal mechanoreceptor terminals.
Nav1.7 is critical for vagal conduction in many esophageal neurons.
